title: TopologyRelationshipSourceReference
description: Typed source reference for a relationship intent when the user names a domain object but the caller does not have graph ids. topology-service resolves and validates the reference against the active graph.

kind.description: Typed natural source reference kind. Use this when sourceSelector cannot safely express a compound identity as one semantic entity.

semanticEntity.description: Semantic entity represented by the source reference, for example inventory.interface.

displayName.description: Display name or label supplied by the user or UI context.

text.description: Bounded source text when the source cannot yet be represented as a typed id or selector.

qualifiers.description: Small typed qualifiers that disambiguate the source reference, for example device name plus interface name, a device pair, a site pair, or protocol plus instance.
